modules.title: 错误率越过阈值后，怎样关联到当前版本
监控要让人作出什么判断

items.title: 选择能反映用户健康的信号
items.text: 登录错误率、下单成功率、请求延迟和关键日志，能让团队看见用户是否真的受影响。指标需要明确时间范围和阈值，不能只堆一张没人判断的仪表盘。

items.title: 告警后要能连回运行事实
items.text: 异常发生时，应能查看当时版本、相关请求和影响范围，再决定暂停发布、关闭功能开关、回滚或向前修复。监控是发现与判断，不是自动修复本身。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 监控不是一次性测试报告，也不是只收集大量日志。它持续产生可判断的生产信号和告警；没有阈值、版本关联或响应动作的图表，难以帮助团队及时止损。

lessonPractice.title: 新版本发布十分钟后，登录错误率从 1% 升到 18%。哪种处理最符合监控的作用？

options.label: 关联异常开始时间、受影响请求和当前版本，再决定关闭开关或回滚
options.feedback: 对。监控要把异常与可操作的运行事实关联，支持及时止损。

options.label: 先看过去一小时的平均错误率；如果均值不高，就继续观察而不关联版本
options.feedback: 较长时间的平均值可能稀释发布后的突增，也无法判断异常是否从当前版本开始。

options.label: 看到 18% 就立即回滚，不检查是新版本、外部登录服务还是监控口径变化
options.feedback: 及时止损重要，但监控还要提供最基本的关联证据，否则可能采取错误动作并掩盖真正来源。

en.title: Ten minutes after a release, login error rate rises from 1% to 18%. Which response best uses monitoring?

options.label: Correlate when the anomaly started, affected requests, and the running version, then decide whether to disable a flag or roll back
options.feedback: Correct. Monitoring links anomalies to actionable runtime facts so impact can stop quickly.

options.label: Check the one-hour average first; if it is still low, keep watching without correlating a version
options.feedback: A longer average can hide a post-release spike and does not show whether the current version started it.

options.label: Roll back immediately at 18% without checking the new version, external login service, or metric definition
options.feedback: Stopping impact matters, but monitoring should still provide basic correlation evidence so the team does not take the wrong action or hide the real source.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为登录和下单配置生产监控：定义错误率/成功率阈值、告警方式，并让告警能关联当前版本和相关请求。上线后检查这些信号；超过阈值时给出关闭功能开关或回滚的明确动作。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Configure production monitoring for login and checkout: define error-rate or success-rate thresholds and alerting, and associate alerts with the running version and related requests. Check these after release; when a threshold is crossed, specify whether to disable a feature flag or roll back.

learning.assumes: You know real users and traffic can reveal conditions not seen in testing.
learning.outcome: You can assign a key user flow an observable signal, threshold, and next step when it becomes abnormal.

modules.title: How an error rate crossing a threshold connects to the running version

items.title: Choose signals that reflect user health
items.text: Login error rate, checkout success rate, request latency, and key logs show whether people are affected. Metrics need a time range and threshold, not a dashboard no one can judge.

items.title: An alert should return to runtime facts
items.text: When an anomaly appears, inspect the version, related requests, and scope, then decide to pause, disable a flag, roll back, or fix forward. Monitoring detects and supports judgment; it does not repair by itself.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Monitoring is neither a one-time test report nor collecting many logs. It continuously produces actionable production signals and alerts; charts without thresholds, version association, or response actions rarely help stop impact quickly.

distinctions.label: Server logs
distinctions.text: {c:monitoring} continuously uses metrics, logs, and alerts to judge system health. A {c:server-log} is one source of runtime-event evidence that can help explain a failure.
